reviews.conclusion: The gap crosses completion. The final End fight gives way to black/credits for 57.5-58.0 s, then returns to postfinish overworld play. This duration is compatible with the -57.5149 s deficit. Credits remove the hunger HUD and exact GUI behavior is unmeasured; no active-run splice is established.

Desert eye throwing contains two explicit menu/control visits totaling 4.75-5.75 s, shorter than the -7.9214 s deficit. Sky-only views additionally show game-paused text at sampled periods; exact menu/mod pause accounting remains unresolved. Repeated eye throws and a calculator overlay provide ordinary play context, not proof of a cut.
Burning portal entry to stronghold is followed by two settings visits totaling 2.25-3.25 s, compatible with -2.7245 s. Profiler/debug windows are not counted as paused.
Ocean portal entry to Nether is followed by settings visits totaling 1.5-3.0 s, compatible with -2.3687 s. The last brief visit falls near the right support; timing is bounded at proxy precision.
During fortress blaze combat, an options/video-settings visit lasts 1.75-2.25 s, compatible with -2.0791 s. Combat resumes afterward; no attempt reset is visible.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
